statistics.classSubtitle: The class against the topics they were marked on
statistics.subject: Subject
statistics.pickSubject: Pick a subject to see its trajectory.
statistics.pickOffering: Pick a subject to see the heatmap.
statistics.zeroFillNote: Ungraded topics count as zero. Hollow points and hatched cells mark where that happened.
statistics.partialPoint: Some topics were never graded — part of this value is zero-fill.
statistics.partialWarning: {count} lesson(s) here were only partly graded. Their hollow points sit lower than the work actually done.
statistics.emptyAxes: No lessons this quarter: {subjects}. Their axes are drawn at zero to keep the shape comparable — that is not a score.
statistics.truncated: The class was too large to draw in full — these are the first rows only.
statistics.assignmentClassSubtitle: The class against the assignments they were set
statistics.attendanceClassSubtitle: The class's registers, lesson by lesson
statistics.pickClassGroup: Pick a class to see the overview.
statistics.assignmentExcludeNote: Unmarked assignments are left out of the averages, so a mean over one mark reads the same as a mean over twenty — read it next to the graded count.
statistics.assignmentZeroNote: Unmarked assignments count as zero, so work set but not yet marked pulls every average down.
statistics.attendanceNote: A lesson nobody took the register for counts as neither present nor absent. Every rate is present ÷ recorded.
statistics.ungradedExcludedWarning: {count} assignment(s) here have no mark. They are left out of the line and of the averages.
statistics.ungradedZeroWarning: {count} assignment(s) here have no mark and count as zero. Their hollow points sit lower than the work actually done.
statistics.ungradedExcludedPoint: No mark entered — this assignment is not in the averages.
statistics.ungradedZeroPoint: No mark entered — counted as zero.
statistics.rowMeanHint: Averaged over the {graded} of {total} assignments with a mark.
statistics.truncatedAssignments: Too many assignments to draw in full — only the most recent are shown.
statistics.emptyAssignmentAxes: No assignments this quarter: {subjects}. Their axes are drawn at zero to keep the shape comparable — that is not a score.
statistics.noRegisters: No registers were taken for this selection.
statistics.truncatedSlots: Too many lessons to draw in full — only the most recent are shown.
statistics.classRatesNote: Two class rates, answering different questions: {pooled}% pooled over every register in the class, and {mean}% as the average of each student's own rate — the second is what the ranking is taken over.
statistics.atRiskExcluded: {count} student(s) have no registers at all and are not listed here.
